entries.final_answer: Hybrid per-flow: refuse + require --force where the user drives the command directly and a flag is natural (intake brief); back up the existing foreign file to a timestamped sidecar + warn + proceed where refusing would break an in-progress workflow (git-hook install during implement — detect a foreign hook by signature, back it up, and surface it in output). Removals remain preserve-in-place + warn via the existing guard.
entries.question: When a mutating flow is about to overwrite a pre-existing user-authored file it did not create, what is the contract?

entries.final_answer: One non-draft PR to upstream for all 7 defects + the census-closure gate. Single issue-matrix and acceptance gate; WPs land as sliced commits with the two P0 fixes ordered first.
entries.question: Should all 7 defects land as one PR, or split the two P0s into a fast-track PR ahead of the P1s?
